actors.name: Santiago Abascal
actors.blurb: Santiago Abascal has been a dominant figure in the Spanish news cycle over the past 48 hours due to his aggressive stance on coalition negotiations with the PP (Partido Popular). His threats to withdraw Vox from regional governments if the PP does not comply with their demands have generated significant media attention. Abascal's rhetoric, including calling Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez a 'dangerous lunatic,' has fueled debates about the stability of Spain's political alliances and the future of far-right influence in the country.
